title: Kineme
description: The smallest recorded unit of observed behaviour: one action over one time span, as reported by the L1 caption stage. Records what was observed; asserts nothing about motive.

source_id.description: Logical sensor identifier, e.g. living_room. Not a device serial.

actants.description: Scene participants as role slots. Never an identity.

objects.description: Salient inanimate objects involved in the action.

action.description: One short sentence describing only what is visible. 'unclear' is a valid value.

location_hint.description: Coarse within-frame region, e.g. 'near the dining table'.

confidence.description: Model confidence in this description. Below 0.5 should be treated as uncertain.

novelty.description: Divergence from recent kinemes, computed by the pipeline from the L0 frame-embedding distance. Not reported by the model. Used as an inclusion weight by L3 summarisation.

keyframe_refs.description: Local paths on the sensor node only. Never transmitted off-node.

spatial_anchor.description: Optional map coordinates. Populated only in robot deployments.

model.description: Model identifier and version, e.g. gemma-4-12b-it@trtllm-0.1. Required for regression comparison.

prompt_version.description: Prompt template version, e.g. caption_v1. Required for regression comparison.

label.description: Anonymous role slot, e.g. person_1, cat, robot_1. MUST NOT encode identity.

category.description: Closed enumeration. An open string makes downstream rules unmaintainable.

reason.description: Evidence visible in frame. Required when level != none. Anticipated risk does not qualify; the hazard must be occurring.
